registration: Written before this analyzer examined any model responses; plan and raw artifacts will be verified separately.
scope: Descriptive automatic diagnostics for a separate OpenAI controlled experiment; not a replication of historical Llama results or a human naturalness assessment.
unit: One distinct selected test group, paired across four conditions and two model snapshots; generations are not independent additional source questions.
normalization: Unicode NFKC; Arabic yeh, alef maksura and kaf mapped to Persian forms; zero-width non-joiner replaced with space; tatweel and combining marks removed; Unicode decimal digits converted to ASCII; casefold; whitespace collapse.
tokens: Maximal Unicode alphanumeric spans, excluding underscores.
exact_copy: Normalized output equals normalized source. This is a wording-retention diagnostic, not an error classification.
overlap: Per-response ROUGE-1/2/L F1 against source and separately against the unvalidated associated corpus rewrite; multiset ngram F1 and token LCS F1. Empty comparison sides score zero. Macro means, no stemming.
length: Unicode token count of output divided by source token count, undefined if source count is zero. Empty outputs are errors and not imputed as normal responses.
numbers: Counter of digit expressions matching digits with optional decimal/date/time separators [٫.,:/] after normalization. Report any-side-number eligibility and source-number eligibility separately. Mismatch is a review flag; number words and semantic equivalence are not inferred.

bootstrap.method: Percentile interval 2.5/97.5 over query-group resamples; identical paired query groups within each contrast; numpy default_rng; linear percentile interpolation.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty, not evidence of human naturalness or semantic correctness. No multiple-comparison-adjusted hypothesis test is claimed.

usage: Recompute from raw provider usage. Uncached estimate is a conservative description, not an invoice; no secret or authorization header is read into analysis artifacts.
missing_and_errors: Count errors and non-stop finishes explicitly. Strict complete analysis requires every frozen job to have one validated raw response and parsed record; failed outputs are never replaced with synthetic text or silently omitted.
integrity: Verify frozen plan seal, input and embedding hashes, script hashes, payload hashes, query/group alignment, effective demonstration counts and train-only example IDs, returned snapshot, finish reason, raw hashes, usage totals, and unique response IDs. Independent implementation imports no generator/harness code.
